signals.title: RDC: des dizaines de morts après la chute d’un camion dans une rivière du sud du pays
signals.summary: Dans le Haut-Katanga, dans le sud de la République démocratique du Congo (RDC), un terrible accident de la circulation s’est produit dans la nuit de mardi 15 à mercredi 16 septembre 2026, à une trentaine de kilomètres du village de Kyubi, dans le territoire de Mitwaba. Un camion qui transportait à la fois des personnes et des marchandises a fini sa course dans une rivière. Le bilan est lourd : 33 morts selon le ministre provincial des Transports à Lubumbashi. Mais des…

signals.title: Court to Rule On Filing Deadline in Ssempijja's Kalungu East Election Petition
signals.summary: [Nile Post] The High Court has not yet set a date for the substantive hearing of former minister and former Kalungu East MP Vicent Bamulangaki Ssempijja's election petition after the respondent, National Unity Platform (NUP) candidate Yusuf Kiruruta Nkerettanyi, challenged the timing of its filing.

signals.title: Kinshasa opposition protest dispersed as clashes leave one dead
signals.summary: Tensions erupted in Kinshasa on Tuesday as an opposition-led demonstration against plans to change the Democratic Republic of Congo’s constitution was abruptly dispersed by security forces.

signals.title: RDC : un mort après la marche de l’opposition à Kinshasa
signals.summary: L’opposition dénonce des violences et réclame une enquête indépendante

signals.title: Arrêt sur images du 16 septembre 2026 : les féminicides en Afrique du Sud
signals.summary: Le corps d'une femme a été retrouvé mardi dans la même région, à l'est de Johannesburg, en Afrique du Sud, où la découverte de plusieurs autres victimes au cours des deux derniers mois a fait craindre la présence d'un éventuel tueur en série.

signals.title: RDC: un mort lors d'une manifestation à Kinshasa, l'opposition en colère
signals.summary: Ce mardi 15 septembre 2026, la manifestation de l'opposition à Kinshasa a tourné court. Dans la capitale congolaise, des échauffourées ont éclaté peu après le départ de la marche. Le rassemblement, pourtant autorisé par le gouvernorat de la ville-province, a été dispersé par les forces de l'ordre bien avant le point d'arrivée prévu proche du palais du peuple où les parlementaires faisaient leur rentrée. Les opposants, qui manifestaient contre tout projet de changement…

signals.title: Land and Environment Secretary due in Macau as Mozambique debuts at global timber forum
signals.summary:
Mozambique’s Secretary of State for Land and the Environment is due to visit Macau, marking the country’s debut at an annual event on the sustainable trade in tropical timber, the Macau Government said on Tuesday. According to a statement, the Global Legal & Sustainable Timber Forum 2026 (GLSTF 2026) , scheduled for 22 and 23…
Source

signals.title: Four Suspected Cattle Rustlers Killed, 35 Cows Recovered in Kwara
signals.summary: [Premium Times] Four suspected cattle rustlers were killed during a gun battle with security operatives in Lade, Patigi Local Government Area of Kwara State, while 35 cows were recovered.

signals.title: Security Agents Raid Kidnappers' Enclave, Rescue Seven in Benue
signals.summary: [Premium Times] Troops of Operation Whirl Stroke rescued seven kidnapped victims from a suspected kidnappers' enclave during an operation in Ohimini LGA of Benue State.

signals.title: Afrique du Sud: une série de féminicides bouleverse la région de Johannesburg
signals.summary: En Afrique du Sud, une terrible série de féminicides bouleverse la région de Johannesburg. En à peine trois mois, huit femmes ont été retrouvées mortes, souvent dénudées, dans un rayon de quelques dizaines de kilomètres. Une série de meurtres qui suscite l'indignation et de nombreux appels à l'action, alors que la lutte contre les violences basées sur le genre a été érigée en priorité nationale par le président sud-africain.

signals.title: JMPD Units On High Alert Following Murder of Women in Ekurhuleni
signals.summary: [SAnews.gov.za] The Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department (JMPD) has announced that it is placing operational units on heightened alert along regional borders to support ongoing investigations into the deaths of eight women in Ekurhuleni.

signals.title: Three Vigilantes Killed in Night Attack in Plateau
signals.summary: [Vanguard] Three vigilantes were reportedly killed by armed men who attacked NTV community in Barkin Ladi Local Government Area of Plateau State on Tuesday night.

signals.title: Morocco Beat Rwanda in Africa Youth Handball Championship
signals.summary: [New Times] Rwanda's U18 men's handball team opened their African Youth Nations Championship campaign with a 33-26 defeat to Morocco in Abidjan on Tuesday.

signals.title: Veteran Actor, Olu Jacobs Is Dead
signals.summary: [Leadership] The film industry has been put in mourning as news filtered in that the legendary actor Olu Jacobs has died.

signals.title: Sernic Incinerates 1.3 Tonnes of Fentanyl
signals.summary: [AIM] Maputo -- Mozambique's National Criminal Investigation Service (SERNIC) on Tuesday incinerated over 1.3 tonnes of fentanyl and an unspecified quantity of chemical precursors in Moamba landfill, in southern Maputo province.

signals.title: Senegal inks deal with Italian energy giant Eni to study 5 offshore blocks
signals.summary: Senegal has signed a memorandum of understanding with Italian energy giant ENI to evaluate five offshore blocks, the country’s energy minister announced on Tuesday.

signals.title: Lagos-Ibadan Gridlock - Motorists Trapped for Hours, Spend Night On Highway
signals.summary: [Daily Trust] Motorists and commuters on the Lagos-Ibadan Expressway were stranded for over 12 hours on Tuesday as a multiple-vehicle crash at the Kara Bridge, coupled with ongoing repair works, triggered a massive gridlock that stretched into Lagos.

signals.title: Mwanza Moves Before El Niño Rains Turn Roads, Bridges and Homes Into Disaster Zones
signals.summary: [Daily News] Mwanza -- WHEN heavy rains arrive, the difference between disruption and disaster is often determined long before the first drops fall. For Mwanza, where roads, bridges, drainage systems, businesses and farms can all face the consequences of intense rainfall, preparations for the anticipated El Niño conditions are already gathering momentum.

signals.title: South African president vows justice as more women's bodies found near Johannesburg
signals.summary: Police have not linked the deaths to a serial killer but are investigating this possibility.

signals.title: Afrique du Sud : 7 femmes retrouvées mortes près de Johannesburg
signals.summary: La découverte mardi d’un septième corps de femme dans l’est de Johannesburg a conduit la police sud-africaine à lancer un avertissement public. Les enquêteurs cherchent à déterminer si ces décès, survenus en deux mois dans la région d’Ekurhuleni, sont liés.

signals.title: Cameroun: une incursion de séparatistes sème la panique et fait plusieurs victimes à Bamenda, dans le Nord-Ouest
signals.summary: Après une journée ville morte, la ville de Bamenda, dans le Nord-Ouest anglophone, a connu un enchaînement de drames. Lundi 14 septembre, une attaque a officiellement fait trois morts dans le 3e arrondissement de la ville. Au lendemain matin, des coups de feu ont perturbé la reprise des activités économiques, interrompues après plusieurs jours de ville morte.

signals.title: Amnesty exhorte l'Algérie à renoncer aux exécutions de condamnés à mort
signals.summary: Amnesty International a exhorté mardi le gouvernement algérien à renoncer à son projet de reprendre les exécutions pour les condamnés à mort.

signals.title: Amnesty calls on Algeria to abandon death penalty plans for wildfires
signals.summary: Amnesty International is urging Algeria to abandon plans to resume executions. After deadly wildfires swept across the country’s northeast last month, President Tebboune called to impose the death penalty on people who start the fires. He said child abductors and abusers should also be executed.

signals.title: Besigye Treason Witness Questioned Over Return to Nairobi Apartment
signals.summary: [Nile Post] Kizza Besigye's co-accused Obeid Lutale's legal team on Tuesday got its long-awaited opportunity to cross-examine British-American Andrew Wilson, a key prosecution witness in the treason case.

signals.title: Nairobi to host the 2029 World Athletics Championships
signals.summary: The World Athletics Championships are heading to Africa for the first time as Kenya's capital Nairobi was confirmed Tuesday as host of the 2029 edition of track and field's premier event.

signals.title: US RELATIONS: Rubio announces US visa curbs for some foreign nationals from South Africa
signals.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Tuesday the U.S. was announcing a new visa restriction policy targeting some foreign nationals from South Africa as President Donald Trump’s administration continues to cool ties with the country.

signals.title: Clashes erupt between DR Congo opposition and pro-govt supporters in Kinshasa
signals.summary: Police fired tear gas as clashes erupted in Kinshasa on Tuesday between opposition supporters and pro-government activists during a rally against a proposed constitutional change, AFP journalists saw.

signals.title: RD Congo : les victimes de l'incendie meurtrier de Bukavu inhumées
signals.summary: 🇨🇩 En RDC, un dernier hommage a été rendu aux victimes de l’incendie d’une école le 10 septembre à Bukavu. La cérémonie a eu lieu en présence des familles et des responsables du M23 qui contrôle la zone. Au moins 26 enfants ont péri dans le drame, selon l’UNICEF.

signals.title: South African police issue alert after seventh woman's body found near Johannesburg
signals.summary: A woman’s body was found on Tuesday in the same area east of Johannesburg in South Africa where the discovery of several other victims in the past two months has sparked fear of a potential serial killer at large and led to a public warning by the police.

signals.title: 38 Dead Following 20 Road Accidents
signals.summary: [AIM] Maputo -- The Mozambican authorities have recorded 38 deaths as a result of 20 road accidents that occurred over the last eight months in the central province of Manica.

signals.title: DRC: Children killed in Bukavu school fire laid to rest
signals.summary: Victims of a deadly fire and stampede at a school in Bukavu, in the east of the Democratic Republic of Congo, have been laid to rest. Relatives and members of the Rwanda-backed M23 armed group gathered to pay tribute.

signals.title: At least 50 soldiers killed in jihadist attack on Malian army base
signals.summary: A large-scale attack on a central army base in Mali last week killed at least 50 soldiers and five Russian Africa Corps paramilitaries, security and local sources told AFP Monday.

signals.title: Buchosa, Sengerema Activate Flood Response Plans
signals.summary: [Daily News] Mwanza -- BUCHOSA and Sengerema District councils have activated disaster preparedness plans following Tanzania Meteorological Authority (TMA) forecasts of heavy rains, with residents urged to take precautions against possible flooding and other weather-related hazards.

signals.title: El-Nino Readiness Intensifies
signals.summary: [Daily News] Zanzibar -- TANZANIA is stepping up preparations for potentially heavy El Niño-related rains, with authorities in Zanzibar ordering drainage systems cleared and emergency services placed on standby while officials urge communities to act before flooding occurs.

signals.title: One of Mondlane's Witnesses in Upcoming Trial Murdered in Morrumbene
signals.summary: [AIM] Maputo -- A member of the National Alliance for a Free and Autonomous Mozambique (Anamola), the political party led by former presidential candidate Venancio Mondlane, was found dead after being kidnapped by so far unknown individuals in Morrumbene district, southern province of Inhambane.

signals.title: Langa Massacre and SA in 1985 — Vignettes for resisting global authoritarianism
signals.summary: Excerpts from Mark Swilling’s new book, 1985: The Langa Massacre and the End of White Rule in South Africa, graphically tell the story of 1985 and why it was a historic turning point that many in our increasingly authoritarian world can learn from.

signals.title: D’El Fasher à Paris : Ousmane Dillo, l’épine dans le pied de Mahamat Idriss Déby Itno
signals.summary: Du front soudanais aux sous-sols de l’Assemblée nationale française : le général tchadien Ousmane Dillo mène un combat armé, judiciaire et diplomatique pour la vérité sur la mort de son frère, Yaya Dillo Djerou, et pour renverser Mahamat Idriss Déby Itno.

signals.title: Mozambique and France to Strengthen Cooperation in Defence
signals.summary: [AIM] Maputo -- The governments of Mozambique and France reaffirmed on Tuesday, in Paris, their commitment to strengthen cooperation in the areas of Defence and Security, with special emphasis on combating terrorism.

signals.title: Ukerewe Steps Up Efforts to Prevent Maternal Deaths, Improve Child Health
signals.summary: [Daily News] Ukerewe -- UKEREWE District Council has adopted sustainable and measurable strategies to improve maternal and child health services and prevent avoidable maternal and neonatal deaths.

signals.title: Opposition Leader Venâncio Mondlane to be Tried for Treason
signals.summary: [Mozambique News Reports And Clippings] Venâncio Mondlane has been charged with treason for his role in the demonstrations November 2024-March 2025 protesting the fraudulent elections of 9 October 2024. More than 350 demonstrators were killed by police, who have not been charged. More than 1000 demonstrators are improperly still being held in jail without trial.

signals.title: 3 Years On, Morocco Earthquake Victims Still Wait for Help
signals.summary: [DW] Reconstruction has progressed in the three years since the 2023 Morocco earthquake, but some survivors are still living in tents. Locals are divided as to how successful it's been, and whether state aid is enough.

signals.title: Benin-Sapele-Effunrun Road - Quiet Engagement, Collective Action Delivering Results
signals.summary: [Vanguard] I joined representatives of the Delta State Government, Commissioner for Works (Rural Road), and Public Information, Mr Charles Aniagwu, the Niger Delta Development Commission (NDDC), led by the Chairman, Mr Chiedu Ebie, Esq., and the Managing Director/CEO, Chief Samuel Ogbuku, PhD, and other relevant stakeholders at Amukpe Roundabout, Sapele, for the flag-off of the emergency intervention and rehabilitation of failed sections of the Benin-Sapele-Effurun…

signals.title: Russia's 'Africa Corps' Massacres Villagers
signals.summary: [HRW] Nairobi -- 9 Civilians Killed, Homes Burned in Islamist Armed Group-Held Village

signals.title: Ebola misinformation fuels violent attacks on health workers
signals.summary: BBC Verify looks at multiple incidents linked to misinformation during latest Ebola outbreak, which has infected more than 1,700 people and killed 580 in DR Congo since mid-May.

signals.title: Mpox Outbreak - Official Calls for Reinforced Prevention Measures
signals.summary: [ANGOP] Cazombo -- The director of the Provincial Health Department in Moxico Leste, Benilde Miguel, exhorted on Monday (14) the public to reinforce preventive measures against Mpox and measles.

signals.title: The Politics and Precarity of Fatherhood in Turbulent Times
signals.summary: [Daily Maverick] At the European Film Festival South Africa, three films trace how fatherhood bends under social and political collapse, exploring absent fathers, surrogate kinship and fragile belonging across nations.

signals.title: Selon les autorités congolaises, le pic de l’épidémie d'Ebola est désormais passé
signals.summary: En République démocratique du Congo, 3510 personnes sont décédées du virus Ebola depuis sa déclaration dans l’est du pays, il y a 4 mois. L’Ituri reste l’épicentre. La province concentre 78 % des cas confirmés. Mais les autorités congolaises constatent une amélioration. Selon elles, le pic de l’épidémie est désormais passé.

signals.title: Guinée équatoriale : faux coup d’État, mais vraies arrestations chez les Obiang
signals.summary: Après avoir affirmé avoir localement déjoué un putsch, Malabo a ensuite démenti sa propre version. Mais les arrestations dans les familles de l’opposition en exil ont bien eu lieu et quatre personnes sont toujours détenues.

signals.title: Lutte contre Ebola en RD Congo : des signes "encourageants", même si l'épidémie devrait durer
signals.summary: La lutte contre l'épidémie d'Ebola en République démocratique du Congo montre des signes "encourageants", a estimé mercredi le chef de l'Organisation mondiale de la santé (OMS), tout en prévoyant qu'elle durerait encore plusieurs mois. À ce jour, plus de 7 200 cas ont été recensés dans sept provinces.

signals.title: 'Prove It,' Nigerians Tackle Soludo Over Debt Claims, Attacks On Peter Obi
signals.summary: [Premium Times] The Commissioner for Finance in the state, Izuchukwu Okafor, claimed during a podcast that Governor Charles Soludo's administration was still repaying loans and other debts incurred by Mr Obi and other past governors of the state.

signals.title: How Six Nasarawa SDP Supporters Died in Auto Crash
signals.summary: [Leadership] Details have emerged regarding how supporters of former Inspector General of Police, Mohammed Adamu, tragically lost their lives in a fatal accident on Monday, with the State Police Command providing insights into the incident.

signals.title: Ruto Escalates Uhuru Attack in Migori
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- President William Ruto has sustained his attacks against his predecessor Uhuru Kenyatta, accusing him of sponsoring opposition leaders as he took his 2027 political battle to Migori.

signals.title: Gachagua Hits Back At Ruto Over Uhuru Attacks
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Democracy for Citizens Party (DCP) leader Rigathi Gachagua has fired back at President William Ruto over his recent attacks on retired President Uhuru Kenyatta, saying the former Head of State is not the President's opponent in the 2027 election.

signals.title: Ebola en RDC : plus de 7000 cas recensés, l'épidémie s'étend à une 7ème province
signals.summary: 🇨🇩 En RDC plus de 7000 cas d'Ebola sont désormais recensés avec 3475 décès. L’épidémie, toujours concentrée en Ituri, s’étend à une 7e province, le Sud-Ubangi. Un nouveau défi pour les équipes de santé confrontées à des attaques sur le terrain.

signals.title: Est de la RDC: quatre mois après le début de l’épidémie d’Ebola, les autorités saluent une légère amélioration
signals.summary: Cela fait quatre mois que l’épidémie d’Ebola a été officiellement déclarée dans l’est de la RDC. Le virus poursuit sa progression depuis le 15 mai et un total de 7 258 cas confirmés ont été enregistrés, dont 3 510 décès et 1 726 malades guéris. L’Ituri reste l’épicentre de l’épidémie, concentrant 78 % des cas confirmés, même s’il y a une légère amélioration dans cette province.

signals.title: Le Sénégal alerte sur une épidémie de diphtérie qui sévit dans de nombreuses régions
signals.summary: Avec 9 décès et 76 cas recensés à ce jour, une épidémie de diphtérie sévit dans 11 des 14 régions du Sénégal, notamment la zone de Kédougou, dans l’Est. Les autorités sanitaires appellent à consulter rapidement un médecin dès les premiers symptômes de fièvre et à se faire vacciner.

signals.title: « Tshisekedi nous a tendu un guet-apens » : en RDC, la mobilisation de l’opposition dégénère
signals.summary: À Kinshasa, la marche de la coalition C64 contre le changement de Constitution a tourné en affrontements entre manifestants, leaders d’opposition et des jeunes désignés comme membres du parti au pouvoir. Blessé, Martin Fayulu a mis en cause le chef de l’État.

signals.title: RD Congo : l'épidémie d'Ébola progresse de manière "exponentielle"
signals.summary: L'épidémie d'Ébola qui sévit dans l'est de la République démocratique du Congo (RDC) progresse de manière "exponentielle" au Nord-Kivu, alors que des signes d'amélioration sont observés dans d'autres provinces, a indiqué mardi 15 septembre l'Organisation mondiale de la santé (OMS). Un défi de plus pour le personnel de santé, qui n'est pas forcément le bienvenu dans les zones en question.

signals.title: Afrique-ONU : 5 questions pour comprendre les enjeux de la 81e Assemblée générale
signals.summary: Succession d’António Guterres, guerres au Soudan et dans l’est de la RDC, épidémie d’Ebola… La grand-messe onusienne s’ouvre le 22 septembre à New York et, cette année encore, des dossiers africains majeurs sont à suivre.

signals.title: Mali : Kamissa Camara, du cœur du pouvoir à l’analyse des coups d’État
signals.summary: Elle fut, à 35 ans, la plus jeune ministre des Affaires étrangères du Mali, juste avant le coup d’État de 2020 qui renversa le pouvoir d’Ibrahim Boubacar Keïta. Désormais, Kamissa Camara cherche à comprendre les motivations des militaires qui ont pris le pouvoir à Bamako, mais aussi à Ouagadougou.

signals.title: Dangote IPO, DRC fire tragedy and regional developments [Africanews Today]
signals.summary: From Nigeria’s landmark refinery share offering to mourning in the Democratic Republic of Congo and efforts to improve inclusion in Côte d’Ivoire, here are the main stories from Africa.

signals.title: Retour sur un été de coupures d'eau et d'électricité en Tunisie
signals.summary: Coupures d'eau et d'électricité à répétition, files d'attente pour quelques bouteilles, élevages avicoles décimés par la chaleur : des millions de Tunisiens ont vécu cet été au rythme des pénuries. Nos Observateurs dénoncent des années de sous-investissement. Les autorités ont acheminé de l'eau fin aout, mais beaucoup craignent de revivre le même scénario en 2027.

signals.title: Niger : quand le pouvoir ferme les yeux sur le narcotrafic
signals.summary: Une nouvelle enquête de "Jeune Afrique" révèle la face cachée des routes de la drogue qui restent grandes ouvertes au Niger. Le journaliste Mathieu Olivier apporte la preuve des liens qu'entretiennent barons de la drogue et les autorités, qu'elles soient civiles ou militaires. Dans cette vidéo le président guinéen Mamadi Doumbouya a été qualifié par erreur de président putschiste. Arrivé à la tête de l'État par un coup d'État le 5 septembre 2021, qui a renversé le…

signals.title: Côte d'Ivoire : le président guinéen Mamadi Doumbouya en visite officielle
signals.summary: Dans cette vidéo le président guinéen Mamadi Doumbouya a été qualifié par erreur de président putschiste. Arrivé à la tête de l'État par un coup d'État le 5 septembre 2021, qui a renversé le président Alpha Condé, il a depuis été élu président de la République à l'issue de l'élection présidentielle du 28 décembre 2025.Cela fait cinq ans que Mamadi Doumbouya est président de la Guinée. Il a passé le week-end en Côte d'Ivoire en visite officielle, où il s'est entretenu avec…

signals.title: Fouzi Lekjaâ : « Premier ministre ? Je vais vous dire une chose, je n’y ai jamais réfléchi »
signals.summary: Depuis son ralliement au PAM, et à moins de deux semaines des législatives du 23 septembre, le très médiatique ministre délégué au Budget et patron de la fédération de football attire tous les regards. Pourquoi est-il entré dans l’arène politique ? Envisage-t-il la primature ? Quelles ambitions nourrit-il pour la Coupe du monde que le royaume accueillera en 2030 ? Qu’a-t-il à dire sur la très polémique finale de la CAN contre le Sénégal et ses relations avec Gianni…

signals.title: 'I've turned the page' - Camara on Chelsea deal collapse
signals.summary: Monaco and Senegal midfielder Lamine Camara says he is moving on from his failed £47.1m move to Chelsea.

signals.title: Were Christians the target of the Palm Sunday attack in Nigeria?
signals.summary: Gunmen opened fire in the city of Jos on 29 March.

signals.title: The Coup Costs More Than the Corruption It Claims to Fix
signals.summary: [African Arguments] Since 2020, soldiers have seized power in Mali, Guinea, Sudan, Burkina Faso (twice), Niger, and Gabon. In every case, the announcement has followed the same script: corruption has hollowed out the state, civilian government has forfeited its legitimacy, and the military is stepping in to restore what politicians destroyed. Crowds have gathered to celebrate in Bamako, Conakry, Ouagadougou, and Niamey, believing that the promise on offer, cleaner…

signals.title: (UN)DIPLOMATIC RELATIONS: ‘Respect our sovereignty’ — SA responds to latest US sanctions
signals.summary: Foreign Minister Ronald Lamola rejects US travel bans tied to a Trump-era order, urging diplomacy as South Africa defends expropriation reforms and faces ongoing legal challenges.

signals.title: Grindstone Ventures Launches $31m Fund for African Startups
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] South Africa's Grindstone Ventures has launched a R500 million ($31 million) fund to invest in technology companies from seed through Series A. The fund, led by Thandiwe Maqetuka and backed by Knife Capital and Thinkroom, is targeting a first close of R150 million.

signals.title: Dangote Refinery Gains From Europe Fuel Shortage With $1.82b Profit
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] Dangote Petroleum Refinery reported $1.82 billion in net profit for the first half of 2026 as disruptions to Middle East fuel exports increased demand for products from its Lagos plant. Revenue exceeded $13 billion, compared with a $476 million loss for all of 2025, according to the refinery's IPO prospectus.

signals.title: UK and Mozambique launch new partnership to protect coasts and support fishing communities
signals.summary:
The UK and Mozambique launched on 15 September, the Climate and Ocean Adaptation and Sustainable Transition, or COAST, Facility, a new programme supporting sustainable fisheries, coastal resilience and mangrove restoration across Mozambique. The launch took place in Maputo, with UK Special Representative for Nature Ruth Davis and representatives of the Government of Mozambique marking the…
Source

signals.title: Pétrole : le Sénégal signe des accords avec Eni pour évaluer 5 blocs offshore
signals.summary: Le Sénégal et l’entreprise énergétique Eni ont signé un protocole d’accords pour évaluer le potentiel de cinq blocs offshore.

signals.title: Sénégal : le gardien de but Édouard Mendy prend sa retraite internationale
signals.summary: Édouard Mendy quitte la scène internationale. À 34 ans, le gardien sénégalais a annoncé la fin de sa carrière avec les Lions de la Teranga, mettant un terme à une aventure marquée par un titre continental historique et plusieurs moments forts sous le maillot national.

signals.title: Édouard Mendy: «C’était le moment pour moi de mettre un terme à ma carrière internationale»
signals.summary: Édouard Mendy a décidé d'arrêter sa carrière internationale. Le gardien de but sénégalais, qui évolue en club à Al Ahli, en Arabie saoudite, l'a annoncé dimanche 13 septembre sur ses réseaux sociaux. Il a choisi RFI pour expliquer les raisons de cette décision. À 34 ans, et après 59 sélections, c'était le bon moment pour lui d'arrêter. C'est l'un des meilleurs gardiens africains de l'histoire qui quitte sa sélection.

signals.title: «C'est excitant»: les Kényans fiers d'accueillir les Championnats du monde d'athlétisme
signals.summary: Nairobi accueillera les prochains Championnats du monde d'athlétisme, en 2029. La Fédération internationale d'athlétisme l'a annoncé mardi 15 septembre. La capitale kényane a été choisie face à plusieurs autres candidats, dont Londres. Ce sera une première : jamais les Mondiaux d'athlétisme n'ont été organisés sur le continent africain. Une décision accueillie avec fierté à Nairobi.

signals.title: Le Burkina Faso se prépare à sa première rentrée scolaire depuis le plafonnement des frais de scolarité
signals.summary: Au Burkina Faso, la rentrée des classes, prévue le 1er octobre, se prépare. Il y a quelques mois, pour tenter de freiner la hausse des frais de scolarité, le gouvernement burkinabè a décidé de les plafonner dans les établissements privés, du primaire jusqu’à l’enseignement supérieur. Les ministères concernés, qui mettent en avant la volonté de protéger les familles contre des coûts de scolarité jugés excessifs, estiment désormais que la mesure a porté ses fruits.

signals.title: Bolt Comfort Rides Grow Sixfold in Kenya

signals.title: HM the King Extends Condolences to Colombian President Following Earthquake That Struck Several Regions
signals.summary: [MAP] Rabat -- His Majesty King Mohammed VI has sent a message of condolences and sympathy to the President of the Republic of Colombia, Abelardo Gabriel de la Espriella Otero, following the earthquake that struck several regions of Colombia.

signals.title: Moroccan Authorities Took All Necessary Measure to Thwart Any Illegal Crossing Attempt Towards Sebta, Mellilia
signals.summary: [MAP] Rabat -- Moroccan public authorities have taken all the necessary measures to thwart any illegal crossing attempt towards the cities of Sebta and Mellilia, and to intercept any individual looking to participate, said on Wednesday in Rabat the Spokesperson of the Ministry of Interior, Rachid El Khalfi.

signals.title: Morocco Aspires to Equitable Partnership On Migration, Protection of Minors - Expert
signals.summary: [MAP] Rabat -- Morocco aspires to an effective and equitable partnership, particularly with Spain, aimed at sharing responsibilities related to migration and the protection of minors, said international affairs expert Mohamed Bouden on Wednesday.

signals.title: Several Moroccan Provinces Brace for Thunderstorms and Heatwaves Expected From Thursday to Saturday
signals.summary: [MAP] Rabat -- Thunderstorms with a risk of hail and gusty winds as well as a severe heatwave are expected to occur from Thursday to Saturday, in several provinces of the Kingdom, according to the General Directorate of Meteorology (DGM).

signals.title: Al-Quds Children Visit Royal Guard Facilities in Rabat
signals.summary: [MAP] Rabat -- The Al-Quds children participating in the 17th edition of the summer camps of the Bayt Mal Al-Quds Asharif Agency visited the various facilities of the Royal Guard at the Mechouar in Rabat on Saturday.

signals.title: Morocco Ought to Be Considered As 'Strategic Partner' for Europe to Build Comprehensive Migration Policy - Belgian Expert
signals.summary: [MAP] Brussels -- Morocco ought to be considered as "a strategic partner with which Europe is building a comprehensive, balanced, and sustainable migration policy," within the framework of shared responsibility regarding a complex migratory phenomenon, said Belgian jurist Geoffroy Generet.

signals.title: Morocco Stands Out As 'Serious, Reliable, Fully Committed Partner' in Managing Migratory Flows - French Expert
signals.summary: [MAP] Paris -- Morocco stands out as a "serious, reliable, and fully committed" partner in managing migratory flows and combating irregular migration, emphasized Jérôme Besnard, a law professor at the University of Paris-Cité.

signals.title: Morocco Fully Assumes Its Role in Fighting Against Irregular Immigration - UN Expert
signals.summary: [MAP] Paris -- The Kingdom of Morocco fully assumes its role and responsibilities in the fight against irregular immigration, stressed UN human rights expert Louis-Marie Bouaka.

signals.title: Morocco Is a 'Vital Partner' for a Sustainable Management of Irregular Migration in the Mediterranean, Says Brazilian Analyst
signals.summary: [MAP] Brasilia -- "Morocco is a 'vital partner' in implementing a sustainable European response to irregular migration in the Mediterranean," emphasized Brazilian geopolitical analyst Marcus Vinicius De Freitas.

signals.title: Morocco's Approach to Combating Irregular Migration Deserves Recognition, Encouragement
signals.summary: [MAP] Dakar -- The approach advocated by Morocco to combat irregular migration and human trafficking networks "deserves to be recognized and encouraged," Senegalese analyst Mankeur Ndiaye said.

signals.title: CAF President Dr Patrice Motsepe Congratulates Indomitable Lionesses of Cameroon On Historic TotalEnergies CAF Wafcon Morocco 2026 Triumph
signals.summary: [CAF] The President of the Confédération Africaine de Football ("CAF"), Dr Patrice Motsepe, has congratulated the Indomitable Lionesses, the Fédération Camerounaise de Football ("FECAFOOT"), its President Samuel Eto'o, and the people of Cameroon following their historic triumph at the TotalEnergies CAF Women's Africa Cup of Nations ("WAFCON") Morocco 2026.

signals.title: World Cup Winner Patrick Vieira Appointed Senegal Coach
signals.summary: [CAF] Patrick Vieira has been appointed head coach of Senegal, taking charge of the country of his birth as the Teranga Lions begin a new cycle following their early exit from the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

signals.title: U.S. Sanctions Two More International Criminal Court Officials
signals.summary: [HRW] Washington -- The United States government on August 18, 2026, designated two additional International Criminal Court (ICC) officials for sanctions under an executive order issued by President Donald Trump in February 2025, Human Rights Watch said today. Those sanctioned are Tomoko Akane, from Japan, the president of the ICC, and Abdoulaye Seye, from Senegal, an ICC senior trial lawyer.

signals.title: Algeria Claims First Wafcon Medal After Shootout Win Over Hosts Morocco
signals.summary: [Ghanaian Times] Algeria secured a podium finish for the first time in their history of the TotalEnergies CAF Women's Africa Cup of Nations Morocco 2026 after overcoming hosts Morocco 3-2 on penalties following a 1-1 draw in regulation time in Rabat.

signals.title: Mali Beat Nigeria Again to Retain U18 Women's Afrobasket Crown
signals.summary: [Premium Times] Mali's victory on Sunday extended its dominance in the competition

signals.title: Morocco Detains Dozens of Migrants Trying to Enter Ceuta
signals.summary: [DW] The attempted crossings come two weeks after around 72,000 people rushed into the Spanish North African exclave from Morocco. Calls for another mass crossing had been circulating on social media this week.

signals.title: $25bn Nigeria-Morocco Gas Pipeline Dream Drags
signals.summary: [Daily Trust] The much-touted multi-billion-dollar Nigeria-Morocco Gas Pipeline is yet to take off owing to the alleged 'lukewarm' attitude of Nigerian authorities, Daily Trust learnt from credible sources.

signals.title: Algeria Edge Morocco On Penalties in Wafcon Third-Place Play-Off
signals.summary: [RFI] Morocco endured a second painful penalty shootout defeat in the space of four days as Algeria claimed third place at the Women's Africa Cup of Nations on Saturday following a 1-1 draw in Rabat.

signals.title: Sicor Stock Gains 42 Percent As BRVM Composite Hits Year-High
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] SICOR Côte d'Ivoire jumped 42.27% this week to close at XOF 10,080, its strongest weekly gain in months. The coconut products maker has now gained 205.45% since the start of the year, making it the top performer on the exchange. Thin trading in the stock continues to amplify price swings in both directions.

signals.title: Idi Amin's grandson fights at Commonwealth Games
signals.summary: The grandson of former Ugandan dictator Idi Amin has caused controversy at the Commonwealth Games after being disqualified for headbutting his opponent.

signals.title: What triggered the mass migrant crossings into Ceuta?
signals.summary: An estimated 60,000 migrants from Morocco have crossed into Ceuta, with dozens dying during the journey.

signals.title: 'Honoured and grateful' - Morocco fan reflects on World Cup
signals.summary: Morocco fan reflects on their World Cup journey.
